completion_gate: The contract carries NO approved_by and NO evidence_eligible field, and asserts nothing about its own standing.
Both arms are specified concretely enough for a different executor to run without asking questions.
The one-sample versus two-sample calibration is DECIDED IN THE CONTRACT with a stated reason, not deferred.
Every decision rule is numeric and pre-registered, with the falsifying outcome named in both directions.
If the budget cannot reach a discriminating sample size, the contract SAYS SO and states what would be needed.
No datum, no factorization, no measured number in any artifact.
constraints: C2 CLOCK: first act, stamp budget_stamps.jsonl with start_utc, start_epoch, declared_wall_clock_seconds and a COMPUTED binding_stop_utc; stamp each section boundary; HALT at binding_stop_utc, record halted_on_budget truthfully and NAME dropped work. Halting is FULL COMPLIANCE.

INFERENCE BLOCK on every artifact: policy, requested_policy, the ACTUAL resolved model, fallback_used, model_verified (false if no adapter probe), standing basis 0137a051eb5828789eb267fa83c8278086578d4c.
TOY TIER. No crypto-scale, medium-scale, affected-scheme or asymptotic claim under any outcome. A recollection may be used neither to promote NOR to dismiss (DEC-20260731-019 ruling 3).
EDIT NO FROZEN ARTIFACT. EXP-SMTH-4403c4 and every BATCH-028 artifact are immutable. A needed change is a superseding contract under a new id.

THE CONTRACT MUST NOT CARRY approved_by, evidence_eligible, OR ANY SELF-DECLARATION OF ITS OWN STANDING. CORR-20260802-757677 rule 4: eligibility is a determination made OUTSIDE the artifact. BATCH-028's contract self-declared evidence_eligible: true beside approved_by: null and both reviewers found it; that route is closed by construction here.
Approval is a SEPARATE record written by a SEPARATE coordinator task that names this contract's sha256. Your freeze receipt records the hash; it does not approve anything.
Produce NO datum and run NO factorization.
deliverables: experiments/EXP-SMTH-e932e8/specification.yaml with ARM 1, THE NULL-SCALING ARM: enlarge ONLY the null arm at CELL-16 by 8x, holding the treatment arm fixed. PRE-REGISTER the decisive prediction -- if the CELL-16 D = 0.004808 is sampling noise it must DECAY AS n^(-1/2) as the null grows, and if it does not decay the separation is real. State the numeric decay band that distinguishes these before measuring.

ARM 2, THE SUPPORT-MATCHED NULL: BATCH-028 observed that all 130816 discriminants were square, so the treatment occupies HALF the support the null samples and no decision rule noticed. Specify a null restricted to the same support, and pre-register what agreement or disagreement with the BATCH-028 null would mean.

THE CALIBRATION QUESTION, SETTLED IN ADVANCE: BATCH-028 applied a TWO-sample KS threshold (0.006373) while its own text called the treatment arm EXHAUSTIVE, which implies the ONE-sample threshold (0.004507) that the observed D exceeded. State which calibration this contract uses AND WHY, in terms of whether the treatment arm is exhaustive or sampled. Do not leave it to be argued afterwards.
freeze_receipt.json with the contract sha256, git commit and dirty-tree state, and an explicit statement that no datum was produced.

dispatches.title: Freeze EXP-SMTH-e932e8: successor contract for the two falsification arms

objective: Settle the BATCH-028 calibration question with the two cheap arms both reviewers independently converged on, and do it under the approval gate BATCH-028 did not have. ARM 1, THE NULL-SCALING ARM: enlarge only the null at CELL-16 by 8x -- if D = 0.004808 is sampling noise it must decay as n^(-1/2), and if it does not the separation is real and the stricter one-sample calibration wins. ARM 2, THE SUPPORT-MATCHED NULL: BATCH-028 found all 130816 discriminants square, so the treatment occupies half the support the null samples and no decision rule noticed. THE STRUCTURAL CHANGE IS TASK-20260802-e2f66c, A COORDINATOR APPROVAL TASK BETWEEN FREEZE AND EXECUTION, whose determination the executor must READ AND HALT ON. BATCH-028's contract ran with approved_by: null and self-declared evidence_eligible: true; here the contract carries NO self-declaration of standing at all, because eligibility is a determination made outside the artifact. Either arm can falsify BATCH-028's headline in minutes of compute, and that is a legitimate and expected outcome.
